create_navigation_env: create a MiniHackNavigation environment instance with default rogue character and 100 step episode limit
customize_navigation_actions: customize the MiniHackNavigation environment by passing custom actions to override the default compass directions
register_navigation_env: register the MiniHackNavigation class as MiniHack-Navigation-Custom-v0 in the Gym environment registry
configure_navigation_character: configure the MiniHackNavigation environment to use a different character instead of the default chaotic human male rogue
set_episode_steps: set a custom max_episode_steps value when initializing MiniHackNavigation to override the default 100 step limit
